values.meaning: Cooldown reduction per stack consumed (basic abilities), against champions/epic monsters
values.quote: reduces the {{sti|'''remaining''' cooldowns}} of '''Varus' ''' basic abilities by {{#var:cdr}}% of each of their '''total''' cooldowns, up to a {{ap|{{#var:cdr}}*3}}% cooldown reduction per target

values.meaning: Blight stack duration (refreshed on each application)
values.quote: apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Blight'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks that apply on-hit deal the bonus magic damage and apply a stack of Blight, refreshing duration on reapplication, up to 3 stacks.
mechanics.quote: '''Varus'''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Blight'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.

mechanics.claim: Varus' abilities detonate all Blight stacks on enemies they hit, dealing the per-stack magic damage and (against champions/epic monsters) refunding cooldown.
mechanics.quote: '''Varus' ''' {{tip|abilities}} detonate all ''Blight'' stacks on affected enemies hit.

mechanics.claim: Blighted Quiver's active/consumption damage is dealt after Piercing Arrow's own damage, as a separate instance.
mechanics.quote: ''Blighted Quiver's'' active damage is dealt after the damage of {{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield does not block the on-hit Blight damage, but will block the stack-consumption (detonation) damage if the shielded target is hit by an ability.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will not block the {{tip|on-hit}} damage but will block the consumption damage if the target is hit by his abilities.

mechanics.claim: If the on-hit damage/attack is blinded, blocked, or dodged, Blighted Quiver does not apply a stack or deal on-hit damage, but the separate detonation (consumption) damage on ability hits is unaffected.
mechanics.quote: ''Blighted Quiver'' will not apply stacks nor deal {{tip|on-hit}} damage if blocked by {{tip|blind}}, {{tip|block}} or {{tip|dodge}} effects.** The consumption damage will not be blocked.

mechanics.claim: Blighted Quiver's cooldown does not start until it is used together with Piercing Arrow (or auto-recast).
mechanics.quote: Starts after the effect is used with Piercing Arrow

mechanics.claim: Blighted Quiver does not count as an ability activation for on-cast effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: ''Blighted Quiver'' does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
